entries.h: BLOCK-20: token operations anchored to Bitcoin blocks
entries.t: BLOCK-20 writes compact JSON into Bitcoin inscriptions. Deploy defines a ticker, transfer moves a balance, and every mint carries the hash of a Bitcoin block. A reader credits that mint only when the named block is genuinely on the active chain, mined after the deployment, before the mint's own reveal, and recent enough. Minting is not open. It is proved.
